# Hitech Insulation

> Hitech Insulation is a pressboard and electrical insulation manufacturer in Guindy, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, in business since 1977. It manufactures electrical grade pressboard, pre-compressed pressboard, machined and moulded pressboard components and complete transformer insulation kits, and supplies epoxy, phenolic, FRP, mica, PTFE and other insulation materials to transformer, motor and switchgear manufacturers across India and for export.

- Address: 7/4, Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai – 600032, Tamil Nadu, India (second unit for pressboard components at Kundrathur, Chennai)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90032 88146
- Email: srk@hitechinsulation.in
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST
- Quotes: within 24 hours from drawings, BOMs or specifications
- Serves: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, South India, North India and export customers
- Not to be confused with similarly named insulation businesses in Hyderabad/Secunderabad or elsewhere.
